description: This file defines the AccumulatorV2 class and related classes for Spark, including specific implementations for Long, Double, and Collection accumulators, as well as internal management of accumulators within Spark.

classes.name: AccumulatorMetadata
classes.description: Metadata for an accumulator, including id, optional name, and whether to count failed values.

classes.name: AccumulatorV2
classes.description: Abstract base class for Spark accumulators, supporting registration, merging, copying, and serialization.

classes.name: AccumulatorContext
classes.description: Internal object managing registered accumulators with weak references, providing methods for registration, retrieval, and cleanup.

classes.name: LongAccumulator
classes.description: Accumulator implementation for summing Long values, with support for count and average.

classes.name: DoubleAccumulator
classes.description: Accumulator implementation for summing Double values, with support for count and average.

classes.name: CollectionAccumulator
classes.description: Accumulator for collecting a list of elements, supporting thread-safe add, merge, and reset operations.

methods.name: isZero
methods.description: Checks if the accumulator is at its zero value.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of the accumulator.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the accumulator to its zero value.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a value to the accumulator.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges another accumulator of the same type into this one.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Returns the current value of the accumulator.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the accumulator.
